Myanmar International School Yangon (MISY) was established in August 2009 and is located in Yankin township, Yangon Myanmar. MISY is an all-through school, catering for students from early years (nursery and reception) to year 13 (sixth form). There are a wide variety of after-school activities, including sports programmes and community based projects to enhance the learning experiences of all students. MISY has a sister school in Mandalay which opened in 2018. This campus currently caters for students from early years to year 13. Both are Cambridge accredited. MISY Yangon became a Council of International Schools (CIS) accredited school in April, 2025 and MISY Mandalay a CIS member school in December, 2025.
MISY is accredited and delivers the Cambridge International Curriculum. Our standards ensure globally accepted qualifications for university entry.
Myanmar International School Yangon – MISY is authorized by the Ministry of Education as a registered private school and is permitted to deliver an international curriculum.
Myanmar International School Yangon was originally established in 2009 with the aim of investing in responsible, innovative and compassionate world citizens.
This vision has been the driving force behind the growth and development of one of the most well established and highly respected International schools in the country.

“MISY is committed to safeguarding; promoting the health, wellbeing and safety of our students.”
We expect all staff and visitors to share this commitment.
At Myanmar International School Yangon (MISY), safeguarding and promoting the welfare of every child is at the heart of everything we do. As a Council of International Schools (CIS) accredited school, we are committed to maintaining the highest international standards of child protection and student wellbeing. Our safeguarding practices are guided by the UK statutory guidance “Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE)”, ensuring robust procedures for prevention, identification, and response to concerns. All academic and non-academic staff receive regular training and are vigilant in recognizing and acting on any safeguarding issues. We work in close partnership with parents and relevant external agencies to ensure that every child is safe, supported, and able to thrive in a secure and inclusive environment.

EAL stands for English as an Additional Language and is offered for students who require extra support or particular learning strategies to aid their English language acquisition. At MISY, the language of instruction is English with the school following the English National Curriculum. As the vast majority of students at MISY are learning English as an additional language, the EAL programme seeks to support learning throughout the primary and secondary levels.
The English as an Additional Language (EAL) Programme is a paid programme supported by four full time EAL teachers and designed to provide academic and social language support for non-native speakers of English from Year 3 through to Year 10. The primary purpose of the programme is to ensure that all students become proficient in English and are able to access the curriculum. Therefore, language skills and strategies are integrated with content area and subject matter whenever possible. The EAL Programme addresses individualized needs and learning styles through; one-on-one, small group instruction, pull-out lessons and in-class support teachers work closely with mainstream classroom teachers.
Our EAL Programme promotes curricular integration and student engagement. We hold ourselves accountable for differentiating instruction and co-teaching with colleagues to best address each child’s learning style and language needs.
For existing MISY students, students may be flagged for EAL support by their class teacher if they are worried about their English progress. At this point the EAL department will test the student using the WIDA model test (an international, standardised English Language proficiency test). New primary students can be referred to the EAL department by the Head of Primary during the admissions process. All students entering into secondary (KS3 and 4) take a WIDA test if possible. Please note that if a student needs EAL support additional fees will be charged for the first year.
The following criteria are used for deciding when a student is ready to discontinue with EAL support:

• words, phrases or chunks of language when presented with one-step commands, directions, WH-, choice or yes/no questions, or statements with with sensory, graphic or interactive support

We recognize that our students come from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and life goals. Each university application must reflect this individuality. From ambitious dreamers to quiet achievers, MISY students embody many different shapes and sizes of ambition, and it is our mission to help each one find the right path forward.
If you are a university representative seeking to meet with or recruit MISY students, please feel free to contact me at ThetHtoo.Zaw@misy.edu.mm.. My role is to ensure I am meeting the needs of our students, parents, and university partners simultaneously.

page_title: MISY – the first and only CIS Internationally Accredited School in Myanmar | Myanmar International School Yangon (MISY)
extracted_text:
It is our great pleasure to announce that Myanmar International School Yangon has recently been awarded Council of International Schools (CIS) accreditation status. CIS is a global membership community based in the Netherlands that includes more than 1,530 schools and universities and represents 122 countries. As a leader in the field of school evaluation and accreditation worldwide, we provide a unique international accreditation with a focus on the development of students as global citizens. MISY is joining this community as the first and only CIS internationally accredited school in Myanmar. We would like to thank the whole MISY community: parents, students, teachers and staff for achieving this remarkable achievement. Please access the link https://www.cois.org/ for the CIS history background and accredited schools.
Myanmar International School Yangon သည် ၂၅-ဧပြီ-၂၀၂၅ နေ့တွင် Council of International Schools (CIS) ၏ နိုင်ငံတကာအဆင့်မီကျောင်းအဖြစ် အသိအမှတ်ပြုခံရကြောင်း ဂုဏ်ယူဝမ်းမြောက်စွာ ကြေငြာအပ်ပါသည်။ CIS သည် နိုင်ငံတကာရှိကျောင်းများနှင့်တက္ကသိုလ်ပေါင်း ၁၅၃၀ ကျော်နှင့်နိုင်ငံပေါင်း ၁၂၂ နိုင်ငံကို ကိုယ်စားပြုထားသည့် The Netherlands အခြေပြု နိုင်ငံတကာပညာရေး အဖွဲ့အစည်းတစ်ခုဖြစ်ပါသည်။ CIS သည် ကမ္ဘာတစ်ဝှမ်းရှိ ကျောင်းများကိုအကဲဖြတ်ခြင်းနှင့် အသိအမှတ်ပြုခြင်းဆိုင်ရာနယ်ပယ်တွင် ဦးဆောင်အနေဖြင့်၊ ကျောင်းသူ၊ကျောင်းသားများ၏ ကမ္ဘာလုံးဆိုင်ရာနိုင်ငံသားများအဖြစ် ဖွံ့ဖြိုးတိုးတက်မှုကို ဉီးစားပေးခြင်းဖြင့်နိုင်ငံတကာအသိအမှတ်ပြုလက်မှတ်ကို အကဲဖြတ်ပေးသည့်အဖွဲ့အစည်းတခုဖြစ်ပါသည်။ MISY သည် မြန်မာနိုင်ငံတွင်ပထမဆုံးနှင့်တစ်ခုတည်းသော CIS အသိအမှတ်ပြုနိုင်ငံတကာစာသင်ကျောင်းဖြစ်ပါသည်။ ယခုအောင်မြင်မှုတွင် ပါဝင်ခဲ့ကြသော MISY မိဘများ၊ ကျောင်းသူ/သားများ၊ ဆရာ/ဆရာမများနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်ရာဝန်ထမ်းများအားလုံးအား ကျေးဇူးအထူးတင်ရှိပါသည်။ CIS ၏နောက်ခံသမိုင်းကြောင်းနှင့် အသိအမှတ်ပြုမှတ်တမ်းများကို https://www.cois.org/ တွင်လေ့လာနိုင်ပါသည်။
